summary: Iteration 60 — verified restoration of the 'Other' submission type (empty string wildcard) end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_other_submission_type.py with 8 tests — all pass. Covers (a) POST /api/cohorts/{cohort_id}/assignments accepts submission_type='' and persists it as ''; still 400s on 'invalid_value'; (b) POST /api/assignment-templates accepts submission_type='' and stores '' in Mongo; still 400s on 'not_a_type'; (c) student PNG submission to an 'Other' milestone — currently REJECTED because DEFAULT_HOMEWORK_EXTENSIONS in server.py does NOT include png/jpg despite the task claim; test uses .mp4 (which IS in DEFAULT_HOMEWORK_EXTENSIONS) to positively verify the empty-type fallback path; a second test explicitly documents the png gap; (d) GET /api/submit-link/w/{week}/{submission_type} still 400s for invalid and 404s for empty (routing) — intended. Frontend: seeded a super_admin session and drove Playwright through both Assignment Templates and Cohort → Assignments tab. Verified — (i) Assignment Templates: 'New Template' dropdown first option is 'Other (any file type)' with data-testid tpl-submission-type-option-generic; selecting it, saving, then observing the card shows badge 'OTHER · 1 milestones' (persistence confirmed). Note: Edit dialog HIDES the Homework Format select for non-questionnaire types (by design in code lines 274-291 of AssignmentTemplatesPage.js) so the 'reopen edit shows Other' dropdown-persistence check is not visually testable via UI — persistence is however verified by (1) badge on card and (2) direct DB inspection in the backend test. (ii) Cohort Assignments tab: dropdown first option is 'Other (any file type)' with data-testid asgn-submission-type-option-generic; selecting it makes the trigger show 'Other (any file type)'. All coercion bugs mentioned in the ticket appear fixed (?? used, no || '60_second_pitch' fallback in onChange, submissionType saved verbatim). No other pages found that hardcode SUBMISSION_TYPE_IDS check without empty-string escape.

minor.issue: Task description claims DEFAULT_HOMEWORK_EXTENSIONS 'includes png/jpg/mp4/etc.' but server.py L1204-1213 only lists docs/spreadsheets/slides/video/audio — NO image formats (png/jpg/gif/webp). A student uploading a .png to an 'Other' assignment gets '400 Allowed file types...'. If image support was intended, add 'png','jpg','jpeg','gif','webp','svg' to DEFAULT_HOMEWORK_EXTENSIONS.

issues: 'Homework Format' select is hidden entirely in Edit mode for non-questionnaire types (AssignmentTemplatesPage.js L274). Users cannot verify or change the format after creation. This is not the reported regression (persistence works — badge shows 'OTHER') but it prevents visual confirmation on edit. Consider showing the select as read-only, or as an editable field, to close the loop.
